rationale: Add pip dependency caching to the test job using actions/cache@v4, keyed on pyproject.toml hash. This is directly supported by experiment evidence (batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) showing 9.2% elapsed time savings on a measured CI workflow on fork for a Python project with similar structure (pip install from pyproject.toml). The workflow uses hatch which relies on pip for dependency resolution, and pyproject.toml is the single source of truth for dependencies. The cache step is inserted after Python setup and before hatch environment creation, preserving all test coverage and behavior. No other optimizations are applied: fail-fast remains false (matrix outcomes needed for alls-green aggregation), pixi cache stays disabled (no evidence for conda-forge caching), and concurrency cancel-in-progress is already present.
